verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an embedded 'AI Assistant' for readers ('I'm here to help you with the docs') plus 'AI search' and 'AI insights' features aimed at answering reader questions from the docs content, and LLM-ready docs infrastructure (llms.txt, per-page markdown) supports grounding. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms the assistant surfaces inline citations/links into source pages, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of answer quality or citation behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on proof that assistant answers include clickable citations into specific doc sections, independent user reports validating accuracy.
